name: Future-bay reserved connection boundary
summary: Marks the intentionally reserved electrical interface for a future bay extension.
description: Marks the intentionally reserved electrical interface for a future bay extension. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Named bus reservation” at the input and “Future bay connection reference” at the output. A reserved boundary does not establish installed equipment.
